Container.Name: emby-insights
Container.Overview:
Emby Insights is a personal, mobile-first media dashboard for Emby users. It complements the Emby player instead of replacing it: personal playback statistics (genres, weekdays, watch hours, longest sessions, most active days), a detail view per title, recently watched content, recommendations, upcoming movies/shows, and optional media requests via Seerr — all in one place, backed by the user's normal Emby login.
The first Emby account to log in via the dashboard is automatically made the Emby Insights admin and configures everything else (library selection, optional Seerr/Radarr/Sonarr/TMDB/OMDB integrations) from the Verwaltung/Admin screen at runtime — no container restart needed.
This is an all-in-one image: the Emby Insights backend, PostgreSQL, and Redis all run inside this single container, persisted under /config. For personal playback statistics you also need the companion Emby Insights Plugin installed on your Emby server: https://github.com/mrt187/emby-insights-plugin/releases/latest
UI is available in German and English, selectable by the admin.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: emby dashboard statistics requests seerr radarr sonarr
Container.Requires: Needs a reachable Emby server (EMBY_BASE_URL) and an Emby admin API key (EMBY_ADMIN_API_KEY, created in Emby under Dashboard -> Advanced -> API Keys). For personal statistics, the companion Emby Insights Plugin must also be installed on the Emby server.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port for the Emby Insights web UI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent storage: bundled PostgreSQL database and Redis session store.

Config.Name: EMBY_ADMIN_API_KEY
Config.Description: Emby API key: Emby Dashboard -> Advanced -> Security -> API Keys.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the bundled PostgreSQL database. Set it once on first start and never change it afterwards, or the database becomes inaccessible.

Config.Name: APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Generate once with 'openssl rand -base64 32' and keep it stable. Encrypts stored API keys for Seerr/Radarr/Sonarr/TMDB; if lost, those become unreadable.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Keep true if you access Emby Insights via HTTPS (e.g. behind a reverse proxy). Set to false ONLY if you access it over plain HTTP without TLS - otherwise the browser silently drops the session cookie and the UI looks logged out / shows no data.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs of an upstream reverse proxy allowed to set X-Forwarded-For. Leave empty if the container is reached directly.
